DM: You all feel this, but Rayna… says that she'll take it. She's seen this vision before. She knows… roughly where this is. “Somewhere off the coast of Apporia,” she says. The crib… “Crystal can guide me, I'm sure,” she says. And so…
is the merfolk city of Omi.

markers.reading: Return to the Leviathan Inn that afternoon and help Rayna settle before her planned later voyage.

evidence.quote: DM: That afternoon, you return to the Leviathan Inn, and begin… whatever's next. Helping Rayna get settled. She's gonna stay another night before leaving in the morning to sail across the big expanse of the Mawar Ocean in the Gulf of Chardon to reach Apporia. And hopefully return this thing to its home. Which… in case it was too subtle for all the tired people… is the merfolk city of Omi. Right.
